g.text: strand A and strand B; filled: paired across
pair across the strands, cis Watson–Crick (G–C, A–U) where it has no symbol
pale: a pair that does not shape the layout (another family, or a tertiary contact)
cHS: cis, Hoogsteen edge with sugar edge; each symbol at its own base
cWS: cis, Watson–Crick edge with sugar edge; each symbol at its own base
other hydrogen bond across, with a sugar or phosphate atom
the ligand, BGD: a line for each kind of contact with a nucleotide (interactions.tsv)
